backup.production_rule: Two nullable columns are added to verifier_findings, one function is added (ack_verifier_finding_v1, owner/admin) and one is replaced (telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1, body cut from its applied migration after asserting the live md5 df569803..., one exact replacement of its update). apply_verifier_run_v1 is untouched (md5 5c02101b..., B126). No row is written by the release. The backup is taken as the LAST act before the apply (D-210).

forward_verification.name: the_two_audit_columns_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'verifier_findings' and column_name in ('acknowledged_at', 'acknowledged_by')

forward_verification.name: the_dashboard_ack_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(p.prosrc) = 'ab4a1f471bd403334600db15da0fb6c6' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.ack_verifier_finding_v1(text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: the_telegram_ack_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(p.prosrc) = '1a25ab60f9f354eed719d77b8fef5736' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1(bigint, text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: apply_verifier_run_v1_is_untouched
forward_verification.query: select md5(p.prosrc) = '5c02101b0c2bd109389ce659702b2270' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.apply_verifier_run_v1(text, jsonb, timestamptz)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: grants_and_definer
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.ack_verifier_finding_v1(text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.ack_verifier_finding_v1(text)', 'EXECUTE') and (select prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.ack_verifier_finding_v1(text)'::regprocedure) and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1(bigint, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1(bigint, text)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.telegram_ack_verifier_finding_v1(bigint, text)', 'EXECUTE')

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
an md5 check fails - that is a mistyped body, not a flaky assertion
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty
